Strings.main.window.title: X MCSV
Strings.main.noServersHint: Install a modpack online, import an existing server, or create one from a server core.
Strings.main.service.updateTooltip: Securely install this GUI's matching signed release into Program Files, then reconnect to Windows Service.
Strings.main.console.commandTooltip: Enter a Minecraft console command; do not include the leading slash (/).
Strings.main.bulkSelection.tooltip: Show checkboxes in the server list to select servers for batch operations.
Strings.main.startSelected.tooltip: Start only selected servers that can currently be started.
Strings.main.stopSelected.tooltip: Stop only selected servers that can currently be stopped.
Strings.main.remoteManagement.tooltip: Manage remote connectivity, account permissions, Web status, and the console.
Strings.main.mobileRemote.tooltip: Configure cross-network mobile access with Tailscale, Cloudflare, or Gmail verification.
Strings.main.webConsole.tooltip: Show the built-in Web and Quick Tunnel status with bounded logs.
Strings.main.players.heading: Player management
Strings.main.players.description: Only online players are shown by default. Sign-ins are added immediately and sign-outs are removed immediately. State is updated passively from server events; the list command is never sent.
Strings.main.players.showKnown: Show known players, including offline players
Strings.main.players.actionsHint: Select a player from the online list or enter any offline player name. The server must be running.
Strings.main.players.name: Player name
Strings.main.memory.heading: Java memory
Strings.main.settings.portHint: Port conflicts are checked when the server actually starts, and the next available server-port is used when necessary. If Query or RCON is enabled, also make sure query.port and rcon.port do not conflict with other processes.
Strings.main.settings.autoRestart: Restart the server automatically after a crash
Strings.main.settings.autoRestartHint: Only abnormal Java exits are handled. At most 3 automatic restarts occur within 10 minutes, with delays of 5, 15, and 45 seconds.
Strings.main.settings.separateDiagnostics: Separate errors and warnings from the console
Strings.main.settings.separateDiagnosticsHint: When enabled, detected errors, warnings, and continuation lines are moved to a separate tab. Disabling it immediately restores combined output. This option is saved automatically.
Strings.main.settings.watchdog: Detect and recover an unresponsive server
Strings.main.settings.watchdogHint: Uses the Minecraft status protocol and never sends list. After the consecutive failure threshold is reached, stop is sent first; the process is forcibly terminated only after the timeout. A diagnostic report is then created before restart under crash-loop protection.
Strings.main.settings.recoveryPoints: Create recent healthy recovery points periodically
Strings.main.settings.recoveryPointsHint: A crash cannot be predicted, so the saved ZIP is the most recent healthy state and is not claimed to be from the second before a crash. Only the configured number is retained. Recovery creates a new server copy and never overwrites the original world.
Strings.main.properties.heading: Raw server.properties editor
Strings.main.properties.hint: Unknown fields and comments are preserved, and a .bak file is created before saving. A running server may need to be restarted before changes take effect.
Strings.main.addons.heading: Modrinth compatible update check
Strings.main.addons.hint: Identifies projects from the SHA-512 of local JAR files and queries releases for this server's Minecraft version and loader. This feature displays information only and never overwrites files automatically.
Strings.main.modpackUpdate.heading: Iterative modpack update
Strings.main.modpackUpdate.hint: Only FTB or Modrinth installations from X MCSV-verified sources are supported, and the server must be fully stopped. A pre-update data ZIP excluding the core is created before mods, configuration, loader, and launch files are updated transactionally.
Strings.main.java.heading: Portable Java Runtime
Strings.main.java.hint: The runtime is downloaded to runtimes/java-version and enabled only after SHA-256 and java -version validation. Java 11 or 16 can also be selected for older Minecraft versions.
Strings.main.backups.heading: World and configuration backups
Strings.main.close.compatibilityRunning.title: Stop all servers?
Strings.main.close.compatibilityRunning.message:
Minecraft servers managed in compatibility mode are still running.

They must be stopped safely before the manager closes so their output pipelines are not interrupted. Servers managed by the production Windows Service are not affected when the GUI closes.

Stop them safely and exit?
Strings.main.close.backgroundJobs.title: Cancel background jobs and exit?
Strings.main.close.backgroundJobs.message:
Server downloads or creation jobs are still running in the background.

Closing the manager cancels these jobs and waits for incomplete files to be cleaned up safely. Continue closing?
Strings.server.oneDrive.performanceWarning: Performance notice: this server is stored in a OneDrive-synchronized folder. Frequent world, region, and log writes can make the entire computer less responsive. Stop the server, then move its complete folder to a local path that is not synchronized.
Strings.server.memory.executableHint: The effective -Xms and -Xmx values are generated from this mode at startup. Moving either slider switches to manual mode.
Strings.server.memory.argumentFileHint: A private .mcsv-runtime/memory.args file is generated at startup. The original user_jvm_args.txt is not overwritten, and legacy settings continue to use the original file until a mode is selected.
Strings.server.memory.autoEstimating: Scanning top-level mods and plugins JAR files in the background to estimate memory…

Strings.server.memory.autoCompleteConstrained: Automatic estimate complete: detected {0:N0} top-level mod or plugin JAR files ({1:0.##} MiB); recommended range {2:N0}–{3:N0} MB with {4:N0} MB reserved for the system. The upper limit was reduced to fit currently available memory.
Strings.server.memory.autoFailed: Automatic estimation failed; current values were kept. {0}

Strings.remote.heading: Mobile remote control
Strings.remote.description: The PC and phone may be on different networks. The built-in Web server listens only on loopback, and public entry points still require a desktop-created account and password.
Strings.remote.service.description: Web, Tailscale Funnel, accounts, permissions, and remembered devices are all owned by Windows Service. Closing this window or the GUI does not stop Web.
Strings.remote.service.securityBoundary: Security boundary: the GUI sends commands only through the administrator named pipe. It never opens a second Kestrel host, tunnel, or authentication database. Only Stop Web disables Service remote access.
Strings.remote.service.initialFullPermissionHint: When cleared, the account starts with no permissions and can be configured precisely below
Strings.remote.service.allPermissions: All product permissions (global or per server)
Strings.remote.service.devicesHint: Sign-in credentials for mobile browsers and apps rotate and can be revoked. The list contains no token or password.
Strings.remote.service.grantLimit: An account can store at most 256 permission scopes. Use global grants instead of a large number of per-server grants.
Strings.remote.service.refreshed: Remote administration data was refreshed from Windows Service.
Strings.remote.service.started: Windows Service was asked to enable Web remote control. It continues running after the GUI closes.
Strings.remote.service.stopped: Windows Service Web remote control was disabled. It will not start automatically until it is enabled again.
Strings.remote.service.reconnected: Windows Service was asked to rebuild the Web and public tunnel connection.

Strings.remote.console.lifecycleHint: The X in the upper-right closes only this console window; it does not stop Web or MCSV. Stop Web ends Web and the tunnel for this run only. MCSV reconnects automatically from saved settings the next time it starts, and shuts down Web and the tunnel when it exits.

Strings.remote.legacy.mode.funnelDescription: Uses a fixed public HTTPS URL without requiring Tailscale on the phone. MCSV exposes only its local Web console through a foreground Funnel.
Strings.remote.legacy.mode.namedDescription: Uses the fixed HTTPS hostname created in the Cloudflare Dashboard. MCSV starts a foreground cloudflared process with the Tunnel Token at startup.
Strings.remote.legacy.mode.quickDescription: The phone does not need Tailscale. A managed cloudflared child process generates a different HTTPS test URL for each connection.
Strings.remote.legacy.mode.tailscaleDescription: Install Tailscale on both the PC and phone, and restrict access to a verified Gmail identity in the same Tailnet.
Strings.remote.legacy.securityStore.protected: Sensitive data is encrypted with DPAPI for the current Windows user.
Strings.remote.legacy.smtp.authenticationFailed: Gmail SMTP authentication failed. Enable two-step verification and use a 16-character app password instead of the regular Gmail password.
Strings.remote.legacy.smtp.deleteConfirm: Remove the stored Gmail SMTP app password? Existing remote accounts can still sign in, but sender settings must be stored again before another registration.
Strings.remote.legacy.smtp.deleted: Gmail SMTP sender settings were removed. Existing remote accounts and sign-in sessions were not affected.
Strings.remote.legacy.smtp.saved: Gmail SMTP sender settings were stored with encryption. The connection will be tested when a verification code is sent.

Strings.remote.legacy.status.refreshRecovery: The remote service is still running in the background. Close and reopen this settings window.
Strings.remote.legacy.status.stopFailed: An error occurred while stopping mobile remote control. Minecraft servers were not affected.
Strings.remote.legacy.tailscale.certificateGuida: Select Enable HTTPS under HTTPS Certificates and complete the one-time confirmation, then return here and choose Apply settings and reconnect. Tailscale first discloses that the machine name and Tailnet DNS name will appear in public certificate-transparency logs; the actual management page remains available only to devices in the Tailnet.
Strings.remote.legacy.tailscale.funnelCertificat: Select Enable HTTPS under HTTPS Certificates and complete the one-time confirmation, then approve the public endpoint through the official Tailscale Funnel flow. The machine name and Tailnet DNS name will appear in public certificate-transparency logs, and the Funnel URL is reachable from the public Internet. Use a local account, a strong password, and least privilege.

Strings.remote.legacy.token.deleteFailed: Could not delete the Tunnel Token: {0}

Strings.remote.legacy.token.saved: The Tunnel Token was encrypted for the current Windows user. Its plaintext is never filled back into the screen.

Strings.remote.legacy.ui.allowedGmailAria: Gmail address allowed to sign in remotely
Strings.remote.legacy.ui.allowedGmailHint: This Gmail address is verified only on the computer and linked to Tailscale remote accounts. It is locked after the first Gmail account is created. Delete every Gmail account before changing it.
Strings.remote.legacy.ui.autoConnectHint: MCSV automatically maintains the Web connection from saved settings after startup. Stop Web ends it for this run only; MCSV reconnects automatically the next time it starts. Web and the tunnel stop when MCSV exits.
Strings.remote.legacy.ui.credentialRules: Usernames must contain 6–32 letters and numbers and start with a letter. A 4-digit password is less secure; 8–12 digits is recommended.
Strings.remote.legacy.ui.funnelAuth: Gmail, SMTP, cloudflared, and Tunnel Token are not used. Sign-in still uses a local account, numeric password, and permissions created only on this computer.
Strings.remote.legacy.ui.funnelBoundary: Only the MCSV Web console is proxied. Minecraft gameplay connections and Minecraft server ports are not exposed.
Strings.remote.legacy.ui.funnelDescription: Funnel provides a fixed public HTTPS URL without requiring Tailscale on the phone. First-time enablement must be approved through the official Tailscale Funnel flow. This feature remains Beta and bandwidth is limited.
Strings.remote.legacy.ui.funnelLocalUrl: Local service URL proxied by Funnel
Strings.remote.legacy.ui.initialPermissions: Initial Web permissions for new account
Strings.remote.legacy.ui.mobileHint: On iPhone or iPad, open the URL in Safari and add it to the Home Screen from the Share menu. Tailscale private network, Funnel, and Cloudflare fixed domain can remember device sign-ins. When a Cloudflare random URL changes, add the new URL to the Home Screen again.
Strings.remote.legacy.ui.mode.funnel: Tailscale Funnel (fixed public URL; no phone app)
Strings.remote.legacy.ui.mode.funnelAria: Tailscale Funnel fixed public URL mode
Strings.remote.legacy.ui.namedDescription: First create a remotely-managed Tunnel in the Cloudflare Dashboard, then point the Published application's Service URL to the local URL below. MCSV runs cloudflared only as a foreground child process and does not install a Windows service.
Strings.remote.legacy.ui.namedPublicUrlHint: For example, https://mc.example.com. Only an HTTPS origin without a path, query, or custom port is accepted.
Strings.remote.legacy.ui.namedTrustWarning: Fixed domain accepts only the managed cloudflared.exe and encrypted installation receipt created by Secure one-click download and verification above. Another executable cannot be selected manually.
Strings.remote.legacy.ui.permissionsHint: Overview and status are basic read permissions after sign-in. Every permission below is enforced by the backend.
Strings.remote.legacy.ui.quickWarning: Quick Tunnel is an official Cloudflare development and testing feature. Its URL may change each time, it has no SLA, and it closes when MCSV exits.
Strings.remote.legacy.ui.recipientGmailAria: Gmail address receiving the verification code
Strings.remote.legacy.ui.registrationDescription: The mobile site cannot register, reset, or change permissions. Accounts can be created only on this computer. Cloudflare and Tailscale Funnel use local accounts; only Tailscale private-network mode requires Gmail verification.
Strings.remote.legacy.ui.registrationHeading: Register remote accounts on this computer
Strings.remote.legacy.ui.securityBoundary: Security boundary: Web does not listen on 0.0.0.0, use UPnP, or create router port forwarding. Cloudflare Tunnel and Tailscale Funnel are public endpoints. External identity headers are not trusted; an account and numeric password created only on this computer are still required. Funnel exposes Web only, not Minecraft gameplay ports. Tunnel Token is a secret; the fixed URL is not a password. The computer must remain powered on, online, and running MCSV, which may be minimized to the system tray.
Strings.remote.legacy.ui.smtpDescription: Only a 16-character app password generated by Google is accepted; do not enter the regular Gmail password. MCSV connects only to smtp.gmail.com:587 and requires STARTTLS. A dedicated sender Gmail without personal mail is recommended, and sender settings can be removed after registration.
Strings.remote.legacy.ui.tokenAria: Cloudflare Tunnel Token (plaintext is never shown)
Strings.remote.legacy.ui.tokenHint: A stored Token is never filled back in or revealed. A new value is used only to store or replace it.
